hypothesis: Firms whose 10-K or 10-Q text changes substantially against the same filing a year earlier underperform; firms that barely change outperform (Cohen-Malloy-Nguyen), on mid caps outside the 100 largest firms.
universe: at least one link from two different edge sources
short side: market cap at least $1B and passes the short crowding filter
signal: For each 10-K or 10-Q, delta = 1 - cos(v_y, v_y-1) between term-frequency vectors of the same section (risk factors, MD&A) in consecutive years (plan/math.md, Text change). Quintiles of delta; the high-change quintile is short and the low-change quintile is long. Rebalance monthly; a name is held about 3 months after its filing. Fills per plan/execution.md.

holdout.rule: unseen-window: no earlier filing-text test touched this window; the plan names no holdout dates

open_questions: universe: the plan says 'as Link Momentum, excluding the 100 largest firms'; the two-edge-source link requirement is carried over and may not apply to a text-only signal.
variants: the plan allows at most 2 Filing Change trials and names none; the two section sets are a proposal.
signal: the plan names the sections (risk factors, MD&A) but not the tokenization, stop words or section parser.
signal: the plan gives no book size (names a side) or gross exposure for Filing Change.
signal: the plan gives no treatment of quintile ties or filings with a missing prior-year counterpart.
split.label_horizon_days: 63 is a 3-month hold in sessions; the plan gives no number.
split.n_splits: the plan states no walk-forward split count; 2 is the validator minimum.
split.embargo_days: the plan gives no number; 0 is a placeholder.
holdout: the plan gives no dates; the free EDGAR feed starts in 2016, and 2023-2026 is a placeholder window.
decision.min_net_sharpe: the plan requires the 95% bootstrap CI lower bound above 0 and states no numeric floor; 1e-06 stands for 'above 0'.
decision.min_days: the plan states no minimum evaluation length for the backtest gate; 1 is a placeholder (MinTRL is computed by the harness).
decision.max_drawdown_pct: 20 is a placeholder; the plan states no Filing Change limit.
decision.new_signal_tstat_min: Filing Change is from the literature, so 3.0 is the validator floor, not a plan requirement.
model involvement: none; if any model component is added the class becomes extraction and an llm block with model pin and knowledge cutoff is required.
